sanskrit:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥ १८-३७॥
iast:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme’mṛtopamam
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam 18-37
translation: That which is like poison at first, but in the end like nectar, that pleasure is declared to be SATTVIC (pure) born of the purity of ones own mind due to Self realisation.
